review_comments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Point manifest links to project-specific URLs**

The `links` entries for `askjamie_hub`, `chatgpt_project`, `notion_workspace`, and `custom_gpt` all point to top-level landing pages rather than the BRG06-specific resources implied by their names. In any workflow that relies on `gpt_manifest.yaml` to locate canonical assets (e.g., automation or reviewers jumping to the project), these URLs will resolve to generic pages and the intended resources won’t be found. This undermines the manifest’s role as a canonical link registry; consider storing the full BRG06-specific URLs instead of base domains.

records.author: OKHP3
records.body:
## Cause
The freshness check scraped a JavaScript-rendered directory page, so CI could not find the current stable channel.

## Repair
Read the backing machine-readable S3 listing and retain the existing configured channel comparison.

## Validation
- Confirmed configured stable-26_05 and latest 26.05 from the backing listing
- git diff --check
- Remote workflow will verify the shell check.
